content:
BUILT CoLAB is organising the Workshop "Circular economy: life cycle view (LCA) from design to deconstruction of the building, the role of project owners", to be held online on 11 January, between 3:00pm and 5:30pm.

The speakers at this event will be Mafalda Mota, from APA, who will address the topic within the current regulatory framework for waste management, José Dinis Silvestre, from IST, whose talk will focus on the LCA methodology, José Paulino, also from APA, and Sara Dias, from IMPIC, who will take a more focused approach on Green Public Procurement. This will be followed by a discussion period among all participants, who will be able to share experiences and contribute suggestions to allow for a broader understanding of the topic.

Participation is free of charge, but registration is mandatory at 👉 https://bit.ly/3m9w3hT.

This is the first Workshop held under the Circular Agreement with the Construction Industry, the Collaboration Protocol between BUILT CoLAB, the Ministry of Environment and Climate Action and the Fundo Ambiental, which also has as partner entities the Confederação Empresarial de Portugal (CIP), CPCI — Confederação Portuguesa da Construção e do Imobiliário, AICCOPN — Associação dos Industriais da Construção Civil e Obras Públicas, AECOPS — Associação de Empresas de Construção e Obras Públicas e Serviços, PTPC — Plataforma Tecnológica Portuguesa de Construção, IMPIC — Instituto dos Mercados Públicos, do Imobiliário e da Construção, I. P., and APA — Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente, I. P.

Find out more about the initiatives under this agreement at https://circularidade.builtcolab.pt/.
